proposition: In exile (ca. 831-32/1428-29) Ibn Turka wrote to Sayyid Murtażā Marʿashī, ruler of Sari in Mazandaran, seeking a stipend (dāranda) on the ground that scholars' work depends on royal patronage; he says he was punished for a full year despite the intercession of amirs and notables, and afterwards thanked the ruler for welcoming him at court, where he spent two days and agreed to stay two more.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to Sayyid Murtażā Marʿashī
mediation.note: Written by a supplicant asking a ruler or official for clemency, relief or a stipend; framed to win the favour asked, not as a neutral report.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: MK thinks two letters were combined here
